label: Bible Study
prompt: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the _____.
verse: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
note: Before day one's light switch, the scene is dark, formless, and wet — with the Spirit hovering over it all.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in _____ resting places;
verse: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
note: A promise of peaceable homes, sure dwellings, and quiet resting places — real rest, at last.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a _____ on his face.
verse: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
note: The KJV spells it 'vail' — Moses' face shone so brightly after meeting God that he had to cover it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And she named the child I-chabod, saying, The _____ is departed from Israel: because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father in law and her husband.
verse: And she named the child I-chabod, saying, The glory is departed from Israel: because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father in law and her husband.
note: Eli's daughter-in-law named her newborn Ichabod on the day the ark was captured — the glory had gone.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a _____ were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
verse: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
note: Jesus' fierce protectiveness of little ones: better a 'millstone' round the neck than to make one of them stumble.
